TechNova Employee Handbook 2024
Welcome to TechNova
TechNova Solutions is a software company founded in 2016 in Austin, Texas. We build NovaCloud,
a platform that helps mid-sized companies run and monitor their data pipelines. As of 2024 we
employ 240 people across three offices: Austin, Dublin and Singapore.
This handbook describes how we work together. It applies to all permanent employees. Contractors
are covered by the terms of their individual agreements.
Working Hours
TechNova operates on flexible hours. Employees are expected to be available during the core
hours of 10:00 to 16:00 in their local time zone, and to work an average of 40 hours per week.
Teams hold a daily stand-up inside core hours. Meetings outside core hours should be recorded so
colleagues in other regions can catch up.
Remote Work
All engineering roles are remote-friendly. Employees may work remotely up to four days per week,
and fully remote arrangements are approved case by case by the reporting manager and the
People team.
Employees working remotely from another country for more than 30 days in a calendar year must
notify the People team first, because this can create tax obligations for both the employee and
TechNova.
Annual Leave
Every full-time employee receives 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to
local public holidays. Leave is accrued monthly at two days per month.
Up to five unused leave days may be carried over into the next year and must be used before 31
March. Leave requests are submitted in the People portal and are normally approved within three

Up to five unused leave days may be carried over into the next year and must be used before 31
March. Leave requests are submitted in the People portal and are normally approved within three
working days.
Sick Leave
Employees receive up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for
any absence longer than three consecutive working days.
Mental health days count as sick leave. Employees do not have to explain the nature of an illness to
their manager.
Parental Leave
TechNova offers 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to the primary caregiver and 6 weeks to the
secondary caregiver. Leave can be taken in up to three separate blocks during the first 18 months.
Employees returning from parental leave may work a reduced four-day week at 80 percent pay for
the first three months.

Learning Budget
Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1500 USD. It can be spent on courses,
conference tickets, books and certifications. The budget does not carry over to the following year.
Purchases above 500 USD need manager approval in advance. Submit receipts through the
Expenses portal within 30 days of purchase.
Expense Reimbursement
Approved business expenses are reimbursed with the next monthly payroll run, provided the claim
is submitted before the 25th of the month. Claims submitted later are paid the following month.
Travel must be booked through the TechNova travel portal. Economy class is standard for flights
under six hours; business class may be booked for longer flights with director approval.
Equipment Policy
New employees receive a laptop, an external monitor, a keyboard and a mouse. Engineers may
choose between a MacBook Pro and a Dell XPS running Ubuntu. Laptops are refreshed every
three years.
Employees also receive a one-time home office allowance of 600 USD for a desk and chair.
Equipment remains the property of TechNova and must be returned when employment ends.
Performance Reviews
Performance reviews happen twice a year, in March and September. Each review combines a
self-assessment, manager feedback and peer feedback from at least two colleagues.
Promotion decisions and salary adjustments are made during the March cycle. Compensation
changes take effect from 1 May.
Code of Conduct
TechNova does not tolerate harassment, discrimination or bullying of any kind. Concerns can be

changes take effect from 1 May.
Code of Conduct
TechNova does not tolerate harassment, discrimination or bullying of any kind. Concerns can be
raised with a manager, with the People team, or anonymously through the ethics hotline.
All reports are investigated within 10 working days. Retaliation against anyone who raises a
concern in good faith is itself a serious breach of this policy.

NovaCloud Product Guide v4.2
NovaCloud Overview
NovaCloud is TechNova's data pipeline platform. It lets teams build, schedule and monitor pipelines
that move data between databases, object storage and SaaS applications, without managing
servers.
The platform has three parts: the Pipeline Builder, the Scheduler and the Observability Hub. The
current release is NovaCloud 4.2, shipped in February 2024.
Pipeline Builder
The Pipeline Builder is a visual editor where a pipeline is assembled from connectors, transforms
and destinations. Every pipeline can also be exported as a YAML file and stored in Git.
Transforms are written in SQL or Python. Python transforms run in an isolated sandbox with a 10
minute execution limit and 4 GB of memory.
Scheduler
Pipelines can run on a fixed schedule using cron expressions, on an event trigger such as a new
file landing in object storage, or on demand through the REST API.
Failed runs are retried three times with exponential backoff. After the third failure the pipeline is
marked as failed and an alert is sent to the configured notification channel.
Observability Hub
The Observability Hub shows run history, row counts, execution time and data quality checks for
every pipeline. Metrics are retained for 13 months on all paid plans.
Data quality checks include null checks, uniqueness checks, range checks and freshness checks. A
failing check can either warn or stop the pipeline, depending on how it is configured.
Connectors
NovaCloud 4.2 ships with 68 connectors, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery,

failing check can either warn or stop the pipeline, depending on how it is configured.
Connectors
NovaCloud 4.2 ships with 68 connectors, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery,
Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe and Zendesk.
Customers can build private connectors with the Connector SDK. A private connector is visible only
inside the customer's workspace and is not reviewed by TechNova.
Pricing Tiers
NovaCloud has three subscription tiers. Starter costs 99 USD per month and includes 3 pipelines, 1
workspace and 10 GB of monthly data transfer.
Growth costs 499 USD per month and includes 25 pipelines, 3 workspaces and 250 GB of monthly
data transfer. Enterprise is priced per contract and includes unlimited pipelines, unlimited
workspaces, single sign-on and a private deployment option.

Data transfer above the included allowance is billed at 0.09 USD per GB. Usage is measured per
calendar month and shown live in the Billing page.
Platform Limits
A single pipeline may contain up to 150 steps. The maximum size of one file processed in a single
step is 5 GB. The REST API is rate limited to 600 requests per minute per workspace.
Limits can be raised for Enterprise customers by contacting the Technical Account Manager.
Integrations and Alerting
Alerts can be delivered to email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty and any HTTPS webhook.
Each pipeline can have its own alerting rules.
NovaCloud also exposes a Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint so customers can pull pipeline
metrics into their own monitoring stack.
Getting Started
After signing up, create a workspace, connect a source, choose a destination and run the pipeline
once manually. The guided tutorial in the console walks through this in about 15 minutes.
Free trials last 14 days and include all Growth tier features. No credit card is required to start a trial.
Deprecation and Versioning
The NovaCloud REST API is versioned. Version v1 is deprecated and will be switched off on 31
December 2024. Version v2 is the current, supported version.
TechNova gives at least 12 months notice before removing an API version, and 6 months notice
before removing a connector.

TechNova Information Security Policy

Purpose and Scope

This Information Security Policy applies to all TechNova employees, contractors and systems that store or process customer data. It is reviewed every 12 months by the Security team and approved by the CTO.

Breaking this policy may lead to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment or contract.

Password Policy

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must not be reused across systems. All TechNova employees must store work passwords in the company password manager, 1Password.

Passwords are not rotated on a fixed schedule. Following current NIST guidance, TechNova only forces a password change when there is evidence of compromise. Sharing a password with another person, including a colleague, is never permitted.

Multi-Factor Authentication

Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every TechNova system that supports it, including email, the production cloud console, the code repository and the VPN.

Hardware security keys or an authenticator app must be used. SMS codes are not accepted as a second factor because of the risk of SIM swapping attacks.

Access Control

Access to production systems follows the principle of least privilege. Engineers receive read-only access by default; write access to production is granted for a maximum of eight hours through the just-in-time access tool.

All access rights are reviewed quarterly. Accounts belonging to people who leave TechNova are disabled within two hours of their final working day.

Data Encryption

All access rights are reviewed quarterly. Accounts belonging to people who leave TechNova are disabled within two hours of their final working day.

Data Encryption

Customer data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher, and at rest with AES-256. Encryption keys are managed in the cloud provider's key management service and rotated annually.

Customer data is never copied to a laptop or a personal device. Debugging is done through approved tooling that masks personally identifiable information.

Device Security

All company laptops have full disk encryption, an automatic screen lock after five minutes, and the company endpoint protection agent installed. Employees must install operating system security updates within 14 days of release.

Lost or stolen devices must be reported to security@technova.example immediately so the device can be remotely wiped.

Incident Response

A security incident is any event that may compromise the confidentiality, integrity or availability of customer data. Anyone who suspects an incident must report it within one hour.

The Security team triages the report, assigns a severity and leads the response. For confirmed breaches of personal data, affected customers and the relevant supervisory authority are notified within 72 hours, as required by GDPR.

Compliance and Certification

TechNova holds a SOC 2 Type II report, renewed annually, and is certified against ISO 27001. Customers can request both reports under a non-disclosure agreement from their account manager.

TechNova holds a SOC 2 Type II report, renewed annually, and is certified against ISO 27001. Customers can request both reports under a non-disclosure agreement from their account manager.

Penetration tests are carried out by an external firm twice a year. A summary of findings is available to Enterprise customers on request.

Vendor Security

Any new vendor that will process customer data must pass a security review before a contract is signed. The review covers certifications, data location, sub-processors and the vendor's own incident history.

A register of all approved sub-processors is published on the TechNova trust page and updated within 30 days of any change.

Security Training

Every employee completes security awareness training during onboarding and again every 12 months. Engineers additionally complete secure coding training each year.

TechNova runs simulated phishing exercises each quarter. Employees who click a simulated phishing link are enrolled in a short refresher course rather than penalised.

TECHNOVA CUSTOMER SUPPORT POLICY
Document ID: TN-SUP-2024
Last updated: 12 March 2024

1. PURPOSE

This policy explains how TechNova Solutions provides technical support to
customers of the NovaCloud platform. It covers support hours, response times,
escalation, refunds and account cancellation.

2. SUPPORT PLANS

TechNova offers three support plans.

Starter Support is included free with every NovaCloud subscription. It covers
email support during business hours and access to the public documentation
portal.

Business Support costs 199 USD per month. It adds live chat, a four hour
first-response target and up to five named support contacts.

Enterprise Support is priced per contract. It adds 24/7 phone support, a
dedicated Technical Account Manager, a one hour first-response target for
critical issues and quarterly architecture reviews.

3. SUPPORT HOURS

Business hours are 09:00 to 18:00 local time, Monday to Friday, in three
regions: Americas (Austin), Europe (Dublin) and Asia Pacific (Singapore).
Enterprise Support customers may raise critical (Priority 1) tickets at any
time, including weekends and public holidays.

4. PRIORITY LEVELS AND RESPONSE TARGETS

Priority 1 means production is down for all users. First response is one hour
for Enterprise, four hours for Business and one business day for Starter.

Priority 2 means a major feature is unusable but a workaround exists. First
response is four hours for Enterprise, eight hours for Business and two
business days for Starter.

Priority 2 means a major feature is unusable but a workaround exists. First
response is four hours for Enterprise, eight hours for Business and two
business days for Starter.

Priority 3 covers questions, configuration help and feature requests. First
response is one business day for Enterprise and Business, and three business
days for Starter.

Response targets describe the first human reply, not the time to resolve the
issue. Resolution times vary with the complexity of the problem.

5. REFUND POLICY

Customers on monthly self-service plans may request a full refund within 30
days of the original purchase date. Refunds are issued to the original payment
method and normally appear within 10 business days.

Annual self-service subscriptions can be refunded on a pro-rata basis for the
unused whole months remaining in the term, minus a 10 percent administration
fee.

Enterprise contracts are not covered by the standard 30 day refund window.
Enterprise refunds follow the termination clause of the signed Master Service
Agreement, which normally allows termination for convenience with 60 days
written notice and a pro-rata credit for prepaid, unused service.

Usage-based charges, such as additional storage or data transfer, are never
refundable because the underlying infrastructure cost has already been
incurred.

6. HOW TO REQUEST A REFUND

Usage-based charges, such as additional storage or data transfer, are never
refundable because the underlying infrastructure cost has already been
incurred.

6. HOW TO REQUEST A REFUND

Email billing@technova.example with the account name, the invoice number and
the reason for the request. The billing team confirms receipt within two
business days. Requests made after the 30 day window are reviewed case by case
and may be issued as service credit instead of cash.

7. CANCELLATION

Self-service customers can cancel at any time from the Billing page in the
NovaCloud console. Access continues until the end of the paid period. Account
data is retained for 30 days after cancellation and is then permanently
deleted.

8. ESCALATION

If a ticket is not progressing, customers may reply to the ticket with the
word ESCALATE. This notifies the duty support manager. Enterprise customers
can also contact their Technical Account Manager directly. The escalation path
is Support Engineer, then Duty Support Manager, then Director of Customer
Support.

9. SERVICE CREDITS

If the monthly uptime of NovaCloud falls below 99.9 percent, affected
customers may claim service credits: 10 percent of the monthly fee for uptime
between 99.0 and 99.9 percent, and 25 percent for uptime below 99.0 percent.
Credit claims must be submitted within 30 days of the end of the affected
month.

10. OUT OF SCOPE

TechNova Support does not write custom application code, debug third-party
software or provide formal training. Those services are available through
TechNova Professional Services at an additional cost.
